data.subject: Public-records research on TRC
data.body:
Hi,

Gem Investment Advisors' most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in TRC, PCYO, and STHO.

On June 30, 2026, Tejon Ranch reported Q2 2026 revenue of $14.3M versus $8.3M a year earlier (+71.7% y/y) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/96869/000162828026054146/0001628280-26-054146-index.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research publisher based only on public records, never issuer-paid. May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
